designSystemProfile.name: July Juddah Certificate Portal
designSystemProfile.description: A clean, minimalist design system focused on typography, generous whitespace, and a muted, professional color palette. Ideal for corporate, tech, or data-focused websites.

style.overall: Minimalist, high-contrast, professional, and spacious. The design relies heavily on typography and a strict color scheme to create a sense of calm and authority.
style.philosophy: Content is king. The design elements serve to elevate the text and data, not to distract from them. Every element has a purpose and there is no unnecessary decoration.

background.description: The primary, clean white background used for most sections.

text.description: Primary text color for body and standard headings.

dark-olive.description: Used for primary call-to-action buttons and highlights.

light-olive.description: Used for secondary buttons and subtle background highlights.

subtle-green-text.description: Used for small labels or tags, like 'Specs'.

light-gray-border.description: Used for subtle dividers and borders.

medium-gray-text.description: Used for secondary or descriptive text.

success-icon.description: Color for success checkmarks or positive indicators.

error-icon.description: Hypothetical error color, maintaining the muted theme.

serif.description: A classic, elegant serif font used for all major headings.

sans-serif.description: A clean, readable sans-serif font used for body text, navigation, and UI elements.

subtle.description: A very light shadow for cards or elevated elements.

navigation.style: Sticky top bar with logo on the left, links in the center, and a CTA button on the right.

featureCard.style: Minimalist icon-and-text block, typically arranged in a grid.

comparisonTable.style: A clean table with minimal lines, relying on spacing for separation.

logoCloud.style: A collection of grayscale logos to denote trust and partnerships.

structure.layout: Single-column layout with centered content. Max-width is generous (e.g., 1280px) to enhance the feeling of space.
structure.sections: Sections are clearly delineated by large vertical spacing (padding) rather than strong visual dividers. Full-width image or color blocks are used occasionally to break the flow.
structure.alignment: Text is predominantly left-aligned. Headings are often centered for emphasis in hero sections.
